name: Easy Pressure Cooker Miso Soup with Tofu, Sweet Potato, Mushroom & Spinach

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Set aside.
Set a 6-quart electric pressure cooker to sauté on HIGH.
While the pressure cooker heats up, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces.

Once the pressure cooker insert is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions, mushrooms, ginger, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 (8 oz) pkg sliced white mushrooms
2 tbsp ginger paste
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add sweet potato, broth, and spinach to the insert (do not stir), then lock lid and set to pressure cook on HIGH for 2 minutes. Once done, drape a clean towel over the vent, then manually release pressure.

When the pressure is released, carefully open and remove a 1/2-cup of broth to a small bowl; add miso paste and chili-garlic sauce, then whisk to combine. Return miso-broth mixture to the pressure cooker, along with tofu, and stir to combine the soup.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup miso paste, white
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Set the pressure cooker to sauté on HIGH and cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is warmed through, 1-2 minutes more.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and drizzle with additional oil. Enjoy!
